cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Help Me Make This Normal
cards.instruction: Get someone to help perform the strange behavior until it feels ordinary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Our invisible dinner guest is here. Will you introduce Mum while I finish the gravy?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't see where to look.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. The chair beside you. Just introduce them as you normally would.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Hello, chair, this is Mum. She needs your seat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Introduce her to the guest, love. Then fetch another chair; we can't ask someone to stand just because Mum can't see them.

confusable: D145 shared performance differs from solitary fantasy or generic cheer.
comparison: Talking furniture hospitality versus invisible guest/Mum seating priority.
seedUse: Keep B seat need causing practical extra chair, not arbitrary magic.
